title: Microsoft 365 Backup: dedicated Microsoft 365 Backup Administrator role
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly describes SharePoint Backup Administrator as covering one workload; Microsoft documents that it covers both SharePoint and OneDrive. The assignment paths, automation, pricing and remaining operational claims are supported, and the briefing correctly reports the disagreement between the roadmap status and published documentation.
